templates.title: Valkey
templates.name: valkey
templates.description: Valkey - the BSD-licensed, Redis-compatible in-memory data store, forked and stewarded by the Linux Foundation after Redis changed its license. Drop-in for Redis clients: caching, queues, pub/sub, streams, and data structures.

env.name: VALKEY_PASSWORD
env.label: VALKEY_PASSWORD
env.description: Valkey password (requirepass).

templates.title: Valkey Cluster
templates.name: valkey-cluster
templates.description: Horizontally-scaled Valkey where the keyspace is partitioned across multiple master shards, each with a replica - the same design as Redis Cluster, BSD-licensed and Redis-protocol compatible.

env.name: VALKEY_PASSWORD
env.label: VALKEY_PASSWORD
env.description: Shared Valkey password (all nodes + the cluster-forming init).

templates.title: Valkey Sentinel
templates.name: valkey-sentinel
templates.description: High availability for Valkey with automatic failover, using Valkey's built-in Sentinel (the same design as Redis Sentinel). One master, two replicas, and three sentinels that watch the master and promote a replica if it fails.

env.name: VALKEY_PASSWORD
env.label: VALKEY_PASSWORD
env.description: Shared Valkey password (master, replicas, and sentinel auth).

templates.title: Vaultwarden
templates.name: vaultwarden
templates.description: Vaultwarden - the Bitwarden-compatible server in Rust: the official Bitwarden browser extensions, mobile and desktop apps, and CLI all connect to it unchanged. One ~tiny container + a 2 GB volume (SQLite, attachments, keys).

env.name: SECRET_KEY_BASE
env.label: SECRET_KEY_BASE
